invariants: request must contain every eligible historical lot 0 through 44 exactly once
Lot45 suspended candidate and Lot46 or later are never eligible
complexity is explicit integer input and is never inferred silently
batching is greedy deterministic and preserves ascending historical lot order
normal batch cannot exceed lot-count or cumulative-complexity budget
a single lot above the normal complexity budget is isolated and never dropped
every batch and the whole plan receive canonical SHA-256 identities
planner is pure and performs no repository audit evidence or business mutation
